name: Return policy
description: Customer wants to return or send back an item they bought.
examples: Can I return something I bought?
can i send back shoes i bought last week?
How do I get a refund for my order?
I want to return this, it doesn't fit

rules.condition: The customer is upset, angry or frustrated.
The customer says the item arrived damaged, broken, faulty or wrong.
The customer mentions legal action, a lawyer, a chargeback or disputing the payment with their bank.
The customer asks to talk to a person, a human or a member of staff.

steps.message: I'm passing this to our team so a person can help. Someone will follow up with you soon.

steps.question: Just to check, is this about returning an item?
Has the customer confirmed that their question is about returning an item they bought?

paths.description: The customer confirms it is about returning an item.
The customer says it is not about returning an item.

steps.text: No problem. What can I help you with instead?

steps.message: I want to make sure you get the right answer, so I'm passing this to our team. Someone will follow up with you soon.

steps.question: Based on the conversation, what condition is the item the customer wants to return in?

paths.description: Not worn or used, still in its original condition or packaging.
Arrived broken, faulty, damaged or wrong.

steps.text: You can return any unworn item within [30] days for a full refund. Start your return at [yourstore.com/returns] and we'll email you a prepaid label.
Sorry, worn or used items can't be returned. If you think something is wrong with the item, ask to talk to a person and we'll take a look.

steps.message: Sorry your item arrived damaged. I'm passing this to our team and someone will follow up to sort it out.

steps.question: Happy to help with that. Has the item been worn or used?
